| "FIRST THOUGHTS: Holy cannoli! Pimples gone in two days, extremely sticky, and almost completely invisible! LOOK: These are probably the best you'll get in terms of visibility. They lie so flat on your skin, when I tried to show it to my friends—they couldn't even see it! I will say, they do have a slight yellowish hue, that can be seen in some lighting, but not a deal-breaker for me. 🙂‍↕️ STICKINESS: Let me tell y'all, I have repositioned these so many times and they STILL stayed all night. Even after reapplying it like 5 times! 🫣 I can even put a bunch of lotion on over them and they don't budge. Not even a peeling edge. EFFECTIVENESS: These will visibly start absorbing stuff without only an hour on worse areas. My acne takes forever to heal, and I'm a horrible picker, so these help my healing time be reduced to around 2 days instead of 5...I even use these on almost healed bumps sometimes, as it really does flatten it and slightly reduce redness. COMPLAINTS: These are SO sticky! 🙈 It's mostly a good thing, but they do leave some residue on your skin...I find it easy enough to wash off, but might be annoying for some, especially if you don't wash your face in the morning. Also, on thinner skinned areas it can feel like ripping off a band-aid! Still doesn't leave a red mark or anything but just thought I'd mention it. 😄 I also notice a little redness & dryness if I use them for more than 2 days in a row :("
